correctness.rationale: For all n≥3 the product of explicit two-state matrices exactly equals every Walsh coefficient. Modulo-2 recurrence of Lucas traces proves no Fourier zeros when 3∤n; the length-three trace-zero block and a length-three -I block prove the opposite implication. Four explicit length-six identity blocks give 3×4^floor((n-3)/6) distinct zeros for all 3|n. All-negative sign evaluation and parity force and attain the sharp positive Fourier gap; the triangle inequality and Walsh diagonalization give the ℓ2 operator norms. Finite checks are supporting evidence only, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full-group convolution spectrum of the Boolean independent-set indicator is a canonical harmonic invariant of the hard-core cycle model. Exact invertibility across an infinite graph family, a sharp least-visible singular value and condition number, and exponentially many explicit null characters are motivated stable structural results, not an arbitrary finite slice or mere total-count recurrence. The result has explicit limits: no exact full zero-count formula, no endpoint pseudoinverse bounds and no noncycle extension.
